At least one. Never invent addresses.", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "To"}}, "required": ["subject", "body", "summary"], "title": "EmailDraft"}

[[ ## completed ## ]]
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Draft this email in this person's authentic voice and email register.
        Ground every claim in the thread history, established facts, and private
        knowledge given; never invent documents, people, meetings, or prior
        statements not present in them. The summary must honestly compress what
        the email commits to.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Lucia Mendes, Senior Accountant, Tax (mid).
Senior tax accountant: partnerships and the individual returns, K-1 season quarterback, keeps the Stonebridge relationship humming.
Personality: Composed under load, dry wit, hates loose ends.
Email register: Crisp and cordial; signs 'Lucia'.
Chat register: Short, precise, occasionally deadpan.
Working hours: 08:30-17:30

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Need Resolution by Friday

Gabriel, Lucia,

We have a recurring issue on the CAM reconciliation for one tenant that needs to be closed out. The disputed line items are back on the table, and I need both of you to review the attached schedules and confirm the final numbers by end of day Friday.

Specifically, I need a firm commitment on the three contested categories – maintenance, management fees, and utilities – and a clear date when the corrected reconciliation will be issued to the tenant. We cannot let this drag into next quarter.

Please send me a joint response with your proposed resolution and a timeline for finalizing the tenant notice.

Evan

[[ ## intent ## ]]
Acknowledge the Friday deadline and confirm the final package is on track, while noting any remaining open item from the dispute thread.

[[ ## established_facts ## ]]
Confirms supporting documentation is complete and audit trail is verified; will do a final consistency check on pro-rata allocation before Gabriel sends the package Thursday EOD; available Friday morning if issues arise.
Confirms final consistency check on pro-rata allocation is complete, package is ready for Gabriel's Thursday EOD send, and offers Friday morning availability.
Confirming final consistency check on pro-rata allocation is done, package ready for Thursday EOD send, and offering Friday morning availability if needed.

[[ ## relevant_knowledge ## ]]
None.

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## draft ## ]]` (must be formatted as a valid Python EmailDraft), and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.
